basic_profile.bio: Hailing from Pittsburgh, I'm a 38-year-old accountant with a deep passion for professional wrestling and vintage bike restoration. My typical day involves crunching numbers at a mid-sized firm, but my evenings are reserved for online wrestling forums and tinkering with my collection of SE Bikes. I'm a night owl, often active on Reddit during late hours. I'm married with two kids and balance family time with catching up on wrestling events and gaming sessions.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a Bachelor's degree in Accounting from the University of Pittsburgh. My expertise in wrestling comes from years of being a fan, attending live events, and engaging with wrestling communities online. My passion for bikes started as a hobby in college and has grown into a small side business of refurbishing and selling vintage bikes.
